# MANSORA Consulting & Business Solutions

> Accra-based accounting, tax, financial management and business advisory firm serving entrepreneurs, SMEs and organisations in Ghana. Promise: "We Make Your Business Better." Values: Clarity, Integrity, Responsiveness, Impact.

## Contact
- Phone: 024 420 5134, 024 421 2404, 025 737 3765
- Email: priscilla@mansora-consulting.com
- Office: Haatso Bohye, Accra, Ghana
- Hours: 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Monday to Sunday

## Services
- Accounting & Financial Reporting: bookkeeping, financial statements, management accounts, reconciliations, accounting system review
- Tax Advisory & Compliance: tax planning, compliance, reviews and health checks, computation and filing support
- Financial Management & Performance: budgeting, cash-flow management, forecasting and modelling, performance analysis
- Business Advisory & Strategic Consulting: business planning, process and internal control reviews, risk and feasibility advisory, growth advisory
- Corporate Training & Capacity Building: financial management, budgeting, reporting, tax awareness, internal controls
